title: Totem Disabler
description: Totem Disabler is a plugin that disables Totems of Undying, so they won’t activate and save players from death.
body:
# Totem Disabler
This plugin disables Totems of Undying, so they won’t activate and save players from death. It’s perfect for SMP and PvP servers that want fights to be more fair and deaths to matter.

## Compatibility
- Tested on: 1.21.8 - 1.20.x
- Other versions: not tested

## Requirements
- Works on Paper/Spigot/Bukkit servers

## Credits
- Plugin created by **[_Melted](https://modrinth.com/user/_Melted)**.
- Inspired by **LifeSteal SMP**.
